about: The frozen bench world of the crew live tests (DEC-089). Paper makes it once from this seed in server-crew/bench/crewbench, livetest.js keeps a pristine copy in server-crew/bench-pristine and restores it before every test, so every run starts from the same blocks at the same spot. The spot is found once by livetest.js bench_setup (the first flat grass spot on a square spiral around the world spawn) and written here.
spot_note: BUG-119 (Oct 31): the first spot, the spawn at 0 137 0, sat on a spruce canopy in old growth taiga (the forest floor is podzol at Y 124), no flat grass lay within 160 blocks. 17 88 -198 is the nearest flat grass (plains, height spread 1), found by scanning every column of the pristine bench world. The old spot runs as CREW_SPOT=0,125,0 (the forest floor).
